item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v4.9.6
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 4.9.6 | SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **about**: Show compiled short Git commit - **metadata**: Add safe batch editing and matching - **library**: Add bulk duplicate cleanup
### Bug Fixes
- **metadata**: Preserve track tags across collection screens - **replaygain**: Report decoder failures and reject incomplete scans - **memory**: Release retired runtimes and idle download heap - **download**: Resolve missing album folders before publishing - **metadata**: Read quality from Opus in MP4 containers - **download**: Remove legacy HIGH quality conversion - **download**: Preserve native containers before legacy quality conversion - **download**: Publish converted SAF files with the final extension - **download**: Size quality picker to its content - **download**: Allow dragging the quality picker to dismiss - **library**: Retain Opus badges when bitrate is missing - **download**: Estimate sizes from track quality metadata - **download**: Compare size estimates at each quality tier - **replaygain**: Write and verify native Opus gain tags - **metadata**: Match recording IDs across inconsistent catalogs - **metadata**: Normalize artist credits and preserve recording versions - **altstore**: Match source bundle ID to released IPA - **download**: Prepare fallback sessions before availability checks - **metadata**: Preserve Opus tags during batch re-enrichment - Restore SAF metadata fallback and preserve active transfers - **download**: Preserve verification provider during fallback - Resolve backend and test analyzer diagnostics - **download**: Route verification notifications to pending challenges - **extensions**: Preserve verification on availability errors - **extensions**: Bound stream resolution without timing out active transfers - **download**: Preserve audio quality across provider fallback - **lyrics**: Align usability checks with shared fixtures - **library**: Bound playlist picker SQL parameters - **playback**: Retain ReplayGain for SAF descriptor leases - **android**: Scope SAF read failures to each descriptor - **ios**: Isolate download progress subscriptions - **metadata**: Preserve Track fields during enrichment - **conversion**: Reserve FLAC outputs without overwriting files - **search**: Let latest live queries supersede cancelled requests - **auth**: Preserve shared signed-session challenge identity - **ui**: Resolve collapsed header title overlap - **ui**: Improve adaptive phone and tablet layouts - **cover**: Preserve provider high-resolution artwork - **extensions**: Shorten verification timeout - **audio**: Preserve Opus codec in M4A scans - **extensions**: Preserve verification callback retries - **conversion**: Preserve Unicode SAF document names
### Performance
- **ui**: Retain platform link lookup across rebuilds - **ui**: Retain track history lookup snapshots - **metadata**: Read complete SAF tags through descriptors - **mp3**: Share bounded ID3 metadata and cover reads - **library**: Page missing-file cleanup with safe SAF batch checks - **extensions**: Clone only the requested storage value - **artwork**: Batch and throttle cached preview validation - **library**: Reuse collection lookups across selection rebuilds - **search**: Decode large extension results off the UI isolate - **library**: Stream normalized scan timestamp snapshots - **cache**: Enforce cover byte budget during foreground use - **queue**: Apply sparse progress updates with chunked snapshots - **images**: Size decoded covers from layout constraints
### Refactoring
- **i18n**: Share supported language choices - **batch**: Share local track actions and phase settings - **ffmpeg**: Remove unused live DASH subsystem
### Documentation
- **changelog**: Document version 4.9.6
### Styling
- **dart**: Apply pinned formatter to existing files
### Testing
- Decouple app fixtures from extension identities
### Chores
- **release**: Bump app version to 4.9.6 - **ios**: Reuse backend build script without duplicate framework setup - Update AltStore source to v4.9.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
### Build
- **ios**: Require iOS 16 and restore local builds
### Revert
- Remove download size estimates
**Full Changelog**: [v4.9.5...v4.9.6](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.9.5...v4.9.6)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-arm32.apk` (older devices)
#### iOS - **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: Aidoku v0.9
item.description:
Aidoku 0.9 | Aidoku
- OCR dictionary support (iOS 18+): import Yomitan-compatible dictionaries in the app and look up words while reading. - Suwayomi built-in source: read and track from a Suwayomi instance, just like Komga and Kavita. - Auto scroll for webtoon reader: enable and press the play button to scroll without touching your device. - Fixed CloudFlare handling: CloudFlare issues that caused external sources to break should be resolved. - Overall performance improvements: the library loads much faster (@Amqx), and the webtoon reader was improved. - Source stability fixes and disable option: the issue where sources were causing the app to crash should not happen again, and now you can even disable a source that is broken until it receives an update. - Many more things: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

item.title: iTorrent v2.2.0
item.description:
iTorrent 2.2.0 | iTorrent
## What's new: * Meet the new built-in VLC player. Play compatible video and audio files directly in iTorrent, even while they are still downloading. * Enjoy Picture in Picture, playback speeds from 0.5x to 2x, audio and subtitle track selection, precise seeking, and system media controls. * Take playback to a bigger screen with AirPlay or a compatible player discovered on your local network. * Choose how pieces are downloaded with Sequential and First & Last priority modes, making it easier to start watching sooner. * Select and share multiple completed files or entire folders in one go.
## Improvements: * Refreshed the interface for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass styling, cleaner dialogs, and more polished navigation. * Made torrent details smoother and easier to use, with clearer download-priority controls and private-torrent information. * Improved media previewing so iTorrent can offer the best available player for each file. * Updated the torrent and media engines for better compatibility, stability, and recovery from unexpected errors. * Expanded and refined translations across all supported languages.
## Fixes: * Fixed cases where magnet links could be saved incorrectly. * Fixed a startup race condition that could interfere with launching the app or completing initial setup. * Fixed toolbars and navigation behaving incorrectly in iPad split-screen mode. * Fixed RSS downloads returning to the wrong screen. * Fixed torrent details sometimes getting stuck in a continuous update loop. * Fixed several playback, AirPlay, and local-device connection issues.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XITRIX/iTorrent/compare/v2.1.1-1...v2.2.0-1

item.title: LiveContainer v3.8.0
item.description:
LiveContainer 3.8.0 | LiveContainer
# LiveContainer 3.8.0
> [!Warning] > The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation. > To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.
# New Features
## Storage Management
- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked) - Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date. - Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.
## Multiple LiveContainers - Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)
## Share to Apps in LiveContainer Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)
## Multitasking
- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208) - Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250) - Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling. - URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.
## JIT - Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.
## TweakLoader You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN
# Improvements - Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194) - IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded. - Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support. - Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress. - Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions. - Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388) - Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)
# Bug Fixes
- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339) - Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209) - Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239) - Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368) - Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347) - Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386) - Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430) - Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329) - Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870) - Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416) - Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)
# Localization
- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS
# Credits
Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.
Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

item.title: Provenance v3.3.0
item.description:
Provenance 3.3.0 | Provenance-3.3.0-iOS
## What's New in 3.3.0
This is a big one. Four months of work since 3.2.1 covering iCloud sync, a completely revamped tvOS interface, video filters, and a ton of core and stability fixes.
### ☁️ iCloud / CloudKit Sync - ROMs, save states, BIOS files, and artwork now sync across devices via iCloud - Real-time download progress indicators when loading cloud save states - Auto BIOS sync on game load when available in iCloud - ROM metadata syncs alongside files - Artwork syncs after library updates - CloudKit records management tab in Settings - iCloud upsell UI for new users with empty libraries - Sync queue pauses during emulation and resumes after
### 📺 New tvOS UI (Default) - Completely redesigned tvOS interface now enabled by default - RetroWave-themed side menu with smooth animations - Save states browser accessible from the main UI with artwork and core name - "View All" saves section with per-system filtering - TopShelf v2: recent games and save states with artwork and timestamps - Cheats UI in the pause menu - Game "More Info" panel - Log viewer tab - Import status view in side menu - Search with persistent history - Dozens of focus, navigation, and theming fixes throughout
### 🎨 Video Filters & Shaders - Unified filter pipeline works across native and RetroArch cores - GB and VHS filters improved - Filters accessible from the pause menu - RetroArch GLES 3D cores now supported (Vecx/GLiden, etc.) - Dolphin shader/filter support - PPSSPP filter support
### 🎮 Core & Controller Fixes - **RetroArch**: Fixed player index mapping for MFi, PS4, and Xbox controllers; PS4 start/select fixed; 32x controls added; GameCube controller responder added - **Mupen64Plus**: Fixed PS4 start button; fixed tvOS scaling and placement; better save error messages - **Dolphin**: Fixed Vulkan landscape rendering - **GenPluGX**: Added CHD support; added wide-screen GameGear core - **PicoDrive**: Fixed crash on unload; fixed 32x controller mapping - **FCEUmm**: Fixed start/select button mapping - **Mednafen**: Fixed DualShock/DualSense pause/play button mapping - **GameBatte / TGDB Dual**: Fixed PSX/Xbox pause/select button mapping
### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability - Fixed multiple app hangs from main-thread Realm access (moved to background) - Fixed crash in pause menu when closing core - Fixed potential crash if audio ring buffer init fails - Fixed crash in share/import extension - Fixed aspect ratio issues in Stella and some other cores - Fixed FPS label appearing in screenshots - Fixed artwork not refreshing in game library after sync - Fixed game importer re-queuing already-imported items - Fixed Realm contentless core crash - Fixed "Continue" carousel metadata mismatch - Skin selector refreshes orientation previews on rotation change - ManicSkin/DeltaSkin files can now be opened directly from Safari - iPad import status modal clipped layout fixed - DSP audio engine fixes
### ⚡ Performance - Artwork loading significantly faster - Game library UI rendering optimizations (removed unnecessary Observable wrappers) - Async tab bar icon loading - CloudKit sync deduplication and repeat-lookup fixes - Game importer skips MD5 hashing for large non-BIOS files
